snippet.title: Time Lords - Lost Amstrad CPC Prototype Found After 38 Years
snippet.description:
A surprise for Amstrad CPC fans today - Time Lords, a previously unknown early flick-screen platformer with beautiful graphics.
Lost for 38 years... and now finally recovered:

https://www.gamesthatwerent.com/2026/03/timelords/

With a huge thank you to Dean Hickingbottom for allowing us to preserve.
